notes: สามี (sǎa mii) is the formal term for husband. In casual, everyday conversation, most people prefer using แฟน (faen) regardless of marital status, or พ่อบ้าน (phâaw bâan) if they want to be humorous or descriptive about the husband's role in the household.
Do not confuse สามี with ภรรยา (phan ra yaa), which means 'wife'.
